test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Uttar Pradesh / accounts for about 16 per cent / of the / country population.
solution:
The correct answer is __**country population**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence tells us that Uttar Pradesh has 16 percent of the total population of the country.
 
• In the above sentence instead of "**country population" it should be "country's population".**
 
• We use apostrophe to show possession of something over the other.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence__: *Uttar Pradesh accounts for about 16 per cent of the **country's **population.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• An apostrophe is a small punctuation mark ( ' ) placed after a noun to show that the noun owns something. 
 
• The apostrophe will always be placed either before or after an "s" at the end of the noun.
